deviations: split, encoder and validation set given by the benchmark (reeval_unified.split_idx, preprocess_data fitted on the dirty training split), not the paper's own split
utility model agglo with the common evaluator's hyperparameters (downstream model of the main table: agglo), not the paper's model list
error types of the real dirty cells are assigned by classify_errors (missing, scaling by 10^k, Gaussian noise otherwise, categorical shift), the paper injects known error types
Estimator posterior in closed form instead of NUTS sampling (same Gaussian posterior)
budget in ground-truth cells (80) instead of 50 cost units; the last step is truncated to the remaining cells

clustering extension: utility = silhouette on 3000 clean validation rows of the labels given by the nearest centroid of an Agglomerative (Ward) clustering fitted on the training rows, number of clusters fixed to 3, the k of the Clean4ML evaluator (distinct gt strings of the clean training split); the label column is not read
Comet works on a fixed random sample of 3000 of the 42000 training rows (seed 42); steps are 1% of that sample, cells outside it stay dirty
command: python baselines/runners/run_comet.py --dataset har --method_name comet --n_jobs 2 --gt_budget 80 --labels dirty --project_root . --output_root results/runs/baselines --records_path results/runs/baselines/records.jsonl
